texts.Permission:Identity.UserCache.Read: View the user cache (list, search, batch, stats)
texts.Permission:Identity.UserCache.Sync: Force user cache synchronization from the identity provider
texts.Permission:Identity.UserCache.Delete: Delete or pseudonymize user cache entries (GDPR)
texts.Permission:Identity.Users.Read: View users directly from the identity provider
texts.Permission:Identity.Users.Manage: Create, update, and enable/disable users in the identity provider
texts.Permission:Identity.Roles.Read: View roles, user role assignments, and role members
texts.Permission:Identity.Roles.Manage: Assign or remove roles from users
texts.Permission:Identity.Groups.Read: View groups and user group memberships
texts.Permission:Identity.Groups.Manage: Add or remove users from groups
texts.Permission:Identity.Sessions.Read: View user sessions and device activity
texts.Permission:Identity.Passwords.Manage: Manage user passwords (reset email, temporary password)
